description: Source code for the ClassInfo class, representing Java classes or interfaces with methods and fields, including functionality for flattening class hierarchies and type normalization.

classes.name: ClassInfo
classes.description: Represents a Java class or interface with fields, methods, and hierarchy information, including methods for hierarchy flattening and type normalization.

methods.name: ClassInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing class name, superclass, and static attribute.

methods.name: getStatic
methods.description: Returns the static attribute (tri-state: true, false, null).

methods.name: isEnum
methods.description: Checks if the class is an enum.

methods.name: isAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if the class is an annotation type.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to the class.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a field by name and type.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Adds a method to the class.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a method by name and descriptor.

methods.name: getMethodIgnoringReturn
methods.description: Retrieves a method ignoring return type differences.

methods.name: hasNoFieldMethod
methods.description: Checks if class has no fields or methods.

methods.name: addInterface
methods.description: Adds an interface to the class.

methods.name: flattenClass
methods.description: Flattens class hierarchy by copying superclass and interface members.

methods.name: normalizeTypes
methods.description: Normalizes type names in fields and methods.

methods.name: mergeFrom
methods.description: Merges fields and methods from another ClassInfo.
